name: Fiddler Eilidh

intro.text: Shetland fiddling is its own thing, quick and Norse-edged, with tunes for every boat and wedding. I'll play you one if you win. If I win, I'll play you three.

win: A cracker of a battle. Have a tune.
after: The fiddle came to Shetland in the 1700s. There's now a fiddle in nearly every house and a fiddler in every second one. Weddings go on for days, with the dancing led by whoever can still stand.
